about: REVIEWED exceptions to the quest data health gate (scripts/questHealth.mts). One entry per page + rule, each with the reason it is legitimate, written after reading the cached page. An entry that stops firing FAILS the gate (absolute and page rules) until it is deleted. 'known gap' entries are parser gaps the gate found on its first run (2026-11-25): real, listed so the gate can ship green, each a follow-up to fix in scripts/sources/questPage.ts and then delete here.

entries.reason: An ITEM page ({{Itempage}}: Sealed Letter) filed under Category:Quests. It has no headings and no steps; its quest is Peacekeeper Staff.
A {{Disambiguation}} hub: its bullets link nine separate bone-chip turn-in quests, each with its own page and steps.
Those bullets are the hub's links to the nine quests, not steps.
A {{Disambiguation}} hub: its bullets link the ten city Bread Shipment pages; the one-line 'hand a Bag of Bread Loaves to the innkeeper' is the whole quest.
Those bullets are the hub's links to the ten city pages, not steps.
A {{Simple Quest}} template page: no headings; the one turn-in lives in the template's turn-in fields, which the catalog already carries as its required items.
A {{Namedmobpage}} (Jarlen Meadowgreen's NPC page) filed under Category:Quests. The removed original quest is prose in the mob template's description; there is no step section.
The four list lines are the mob template's empty known_loot / factions fields ('* Unknown').
'Step 1:' / 'Step 2:' are the Walkthrough's two stages written at the Walkthrough's own heading level. The page's Checklist is what the parser reads, by design (the most condensed list wins).

known gap: '== Checklist =={{CheckboxList}}' has the template on the heading line, so the parser does not see the heading; its four checklist lines land in the Reward section (they read as rewards) and the steps come from the Walkthrough.
known gap: the same unseen '== Checklist ==' heading as the unparsed-heading entry.
known gap: '==== Dreadscale Helm ===={{CheckboxList}}' (template on the heading line); the helm's lines join the section above it (Sirtha Scarscale).
known gap: '===Ivy Etched Tunic==={{CheckboxList}}' (template on the heading line); the tunic's lines join the section above it (Gandari).
known gap: '=== Breastplate ==={{CheckboxList}}' (template on the heading line); the breastplate's lines join the section above it (the Walkthrough's opening lines).
known gap: three '== <piece> =={{CheckboxList}}' headings (Boots, Gloves, Robe of Enshroudment) with the template on the heading line; their checklist lines land in the Rewards section above them.
known gap: 'Items Required' (Bozinite Pestle, which the body also links, so it is a required item anyway) and 'Related Creatures' (Myre, Cleaner VII, two rats) are not read.
known gap: 'Related Items' (Lizard Tail, also linked in the body, so it is a required item anyway) is not read.
known gap: 'Location' states the giver's spot, '50% @ (1064, 2409)'; the catalog has no field for a giver location.
known gap: 'Location' states the giver's spots, '890,-75 (inside building); 825,-28, 1100, -300 (after 8PM game time)'; the catalog has no field for a giver location.
known gap: the reward (Intensify Death) is stated ONLY in the top table's 'Reward' row, so the catalog has no reward for this quest.
